src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Jobs/DailyE.name: Daily entry auto-lock
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Jobs/DailyE.description: Locks submitted daily entries once they are over 7 days old, counted in the farm's own time zone.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Jobs/Durabl.name: Background job runner
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Jobs/Durabl.description: Runs queued background tasks and recurring clean-ups, only on the one server currently in charge.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Jobs/Durabl.name: Job runner heartbeat
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Jobs/Durabl.description: A live signal the job runner updates so the health check can tell it is still working.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Jobs/Idempo.name: Repeat-request clean-up
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Jobs/Idempo.description: Deletes old records used to stop repeated requests from running twice, after about 48 hours.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Jobs/ILeade.name: Single-runner gate
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Jobs/ILeade.description: Makes sure only one server at a time runs the background jobs; includes a version that is always in charge for single-server setups.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Jobs/Postgr.name: Database job leader lock
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Jobs/Postgr.description: Uses a database lock so only one of several servers runs the background jobs.

src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Jobs/Refres.name: Old login token clean-up
src/Cluckwork.Infrastructure/Jobs/Refres.description: Deletes expired and revoked stay-signed-in records that would otherwise pile up forever.
